maddeler.e:
نزدهر (form VIII)
# نَزْدَهِرُ (nazdahiru) /naz.da.hi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَهَرَ (izdahara)
# نَزْدَهِرَ (nazdahira) /naz.da.hi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَهَرَ (izdahara)
# نَزْدَهِرْ (nazdahir) /naz.da.hir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِزْدَهَرَ (izdahara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
